questions.def: 'Run into' means to meet someone unexpectedly.
questions.question: I ran ___ my old friend at the store.

questions.def: 'Put on' means to wear something.
questions.question: She put ___ her coat because it was cold.

questions.def: The correct form is 'take after' (no -s for he/she/it).
questions.question: He takes after his mother in many ways.

questions.def: 'Look up' means to find information.
questions.question: They ___ the phone number in the directory.

questions.def: 'Called off' means cancelled.
questions.question: The meeting was called ___ due to the storm.

questions.def: 'Throw away' means to get rid of.
questions.question: I need to throw ___ these old clothes.

questions.def: 'Give out' means to distribute.
questions.question: The teacher ___ the homework to the students.

questions.def: 'Work out' means to find a solution.
questions.question: He needs to work ___ a solution to this problem.

questions.def: 'Look for' means to search for.
questions.question: They are looking ___ a new apartment.

questions.def: 'Turn off' means to switch off.
questions.question: Please ___ the lights when you leave.

questions.def: 'Take after' means to resemble.
questions.question: She takes ___ her mother, they are very similar.

questions.def: 'Turn down' means to reject.
questions.question: He turned ___ the job offer because it wasn't good enough.

questions.def: 'Put down' (volume) means to reduce the level.
questions.question: Can you ___ the music, please? It's too loud.

questions.def: 'Carry out' means to perform or conduct.
questions.question: The company carried ___ the research project.

questions.def: 'Bring up' means to raise a child.
questions.question: She is bringing ___ her children well.

questions.def: 'Find out' means to discover information.
questions.question: I need to ___ more about this topic.

questions.def: 'End up' means to reach a final state.
questions.question: He ended ___ living in another country.

questions.def: 'Fill in' means to complete a form.
questions.question: Please fill ___ this form before you leave.

questions.def: 'Get up' means to wake up.
questions.question: I need to ___ early tomorrow morning.

questions.def: 'Look forward to' means to anticipate with pleasure.
questions.question: I am looking ___ to the weekend.

questions.def: 'Take off' means to depart (airplane).
questions.question: The plane took ___ on time.

questions.def: 'Call off' means to cancel.
questions.question: We had to ___ the meeting because of the rain.

questions.def: 'Come into' means to inherit.
questions.question: She came ___ a lot of money when her grandfather died.

questions.def: 'Get on' means to have a good relationship.
questions.question: I get ___ well with my neighbours.

questions.def: 'Run into' means to meet someone unexpectedly.
questions.question: I ran ___ my old friend at the store.

questions.def: 'Throw away' means to get rid of something you don't need.
questions.question: Please throw ___ that old newspaper.

questions.def: 'Put off' means to postpone or delay something.
questions.question: They had to ___ the meeting because of the rain.

questions.def: 'Give up' means to stop doing something.
questions.question: He gave ___ smoking last year.

questions.def: 'Make out' means to understand or hear something with difficulty.
questions.question: The music was so loud I couldn't make ___ what he was saying.

questions.def: 'Get on with' means to start or continue doing something.
questions.question: It's time to ___ with your homework.
